name: Multiscale Hard Voxelization
definition: A CUDA operator that voxelizes a LiDAR point cloud into multiple scales simultaneously, outputting voxel features, coordinates, and point counts per voxel for each scale.
summary: Multiscale Hard Voxelization is a CUDA operator that simultaneously voxelizes LiDAR point clouds into multiple spatial scales, storing results in separate memory blocks for efficient multi-scale feature extraction.
